Theorem
[Matrix Harnack estimate for Ricci flow] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0395 ↗ thm:chow-ii-hamilton-matrix-harnack 1. appD:D.27\group Harnack Estimates

For a complete bounded-curvature Ricci flow with nonnegative curvature operator, Hamilton's Harnack quadratic satisfies \[ M_{ij}W^iW^j+2P_{pij}U^{pi}W^j+R_{pijq}U^{pi}U^{qj}\geq 0 \] for every one-form $W$ and two-form $U$.
